note: Register of processing activities and their lawful bases. The software is the same everywhere; each operator deployment is the controller for what its node publishes and must confirm or amend this register in its own copy. Bases cite GDPR Article 6 (and Article 9 where relevant) plus the Philippine DPA 2012 counterpart.

activities.activity: Registry statements vouching for a key
activities.description: An institution publishes identity.attest entries binding a public key to claims (legal name, role, label). The subject's own consent is recorded separately by the enrollment ceremony.

legal_basis.name: Exercise of official authority / public task of the registry
legal_basis.ph_dpa: DPA 2012 Sec. 13(a)-(c) (public function, legal obligation, contract)

activities.retention: append-only while mirrors hold the entries; revocation is a new statement
activities.recipients: every mirror of the ledger (public by design)

activities.description: The citizen signs the enrollment document with the key being enrolled; the signature is the consent record and is published inside the identity.enroll entry.
activities.retention: append-only; withdrawal by revocation, never by deletion

activities.activity: Guardian recovery of a lost key
activities.description: The holder of a NEW key opens a recovery for a lost one; distinct guardians co-sign; the registry attests the new key and revokes the lost one in the same act.

legal_basis.name: Consent of the citizen (new key) and of each guardian co-signer

activities.retention: append-only; the lost key is revoked in the same act

activities.description: Operators publish records about people (for example land titles) as party-signed documents: the affected parties sign the exact document before publication.
data_categories: any fields the operator publishes or seals

legal_basis.name: Public task of the operator (or 6(1)(b)/(c) as its mandate dictates)
legal_basis.ph_dpa: DPA 2012 Sec. 12-13 as applicable to the operator

activities.retention: append-only; personal fields must be sealed or omitted

activities.description: Witnesses sign checkpoint streams over ranges of entries. The only personal data involved is public keys.

legal_basis.name: Legitimate interests: integrity and tamper evidence

activities.recipients: every mirror that exchanges checkpoint streams

activities.description: A relying party verifies a signed challenge; no password is stored and the assertion is single-use. The relying party holds a session token after login under its own basis.

legal_basis.name: Contract: delivering the service you sign in to

activities.retention: relying party's session policy; the ledger holds nothing for a login

activities.description: A node may log IP addresses and request lines for security and rate limiting. These logs are local, never synced to peers.

legal_basis.name: Legitimate interests: security and abuse prevention

activities.retention: operator policy (typical: 30 days); documented in deploy/operations/

activities.description: Each node records where an entry first arrived from (local, peer address, bundle, delta) for tamper detection. It is a local note: never signed, never synced, never served.

legal_basis.name: Legitimate interests: integrity of the local store

activities.retention: local to the node; discarded with the store

activities.description: Operators encrypt personal fields to named readers before publishing; the ciphertext may be on the ledger, the key half stays with the operator or is released time-locked.

legal_basis.name: Inherits the operator's basis for the underlying record

activities.retention: operator policy; ciphertext alone is not personal data without the key half
activities.recipients: authorized readers named at seal time

activities.description: An optional indexer copies entries into SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL for querying. It is derived, disposable data and inherits the basis of the entries it copies.

legal_basis.name: Inherits the basis of the source entries

activities.retention: operator policy; drop and replay is safe
